no_scale.report_html:
Structural finding, UPLOAD

Track demo · Outcome REFUSED · Stage S1 calibration

Verdict

No observation was made. This is not a negative result and not a measurement of zero. Nothing was measured.

Why

  • Code: F1_NO_CALIBRATION_DECLARED
  • No pixel scale was declared, so no micron quantity can be computed and no candidate object can be selected: the selector's size bounds are declared in um^2, a property of erythrocytes rather than of a camera, and converting them to px^2 requires um/pixel. Declaring a scale is the repair.

What was received

  • Slide preparation declared: THIN_FILM
  • Optical configuration: 100x oil/illustrative-camera/1.0x@1x
  • Calibration source: STAGE_MICROMETER

None. No quantity is stated anywhere in this document, so there is nothing here that could be read as a result.

Declined

Declaring a scale is the repair.

What this report does not say

  • It does not say the specimen is normal or abnormal.

Structural finding, UPLOAD

Track demo · Outcome REFUSED · Stage S0a preparation

Verdict

Why

  • Code: F12_PREPARATION_NOT_APPLICABLE
  • OBS-RBC-SHAPE is declared for THIN_FILM and the slide is a THICK_FILM, so this observation is not assessable on this preparation.
